definitions.explanation: Spoken communication in English, as opposed to reading or writing English.
A class, lesson, or school focused on teaching spoken English. Very commonly used in this sense in everyday Japanese.

examples.japanese: {英会話|えいかいわ}が{苦手|にがて}です。
examples.english: I'm not good at English conversation.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}で{英会話|えいかいわ}が{必要|ひつよう}になった。
examples.english: I started needing English conversation skills for work.

examples.japanese: {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}の{前|まえ}に{英会話|えいかいわ}を{練習|れんしゅう}しておこう。
examples.english: Let's practice English conversation before the trip abroad.

examples.japanese: {英会話|えいかいわ}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I go to English conversation classes.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{英会話|えいかいわ}スクールに{入会|にゅうかい}した。
examples.english: I enrolled in the English conversation school near the station.

examples.japanese: オンライン{英会話|えいかいわ}なら{自宅|じたく}で{好|す}きな{時間|じかん}にレッスンが{受|う}けられる。
examples.english: With online English conversation lessons, you can take classes at home whenever you like.

notes:
A compound of {英|えい} (English) and {会話|かいわ} (conversation). In practice, sense 2 (classes/schools) is extremely common — {英会話|えいかいわ}に{通|かよ}う means "to attend English conversation classes," not simply "to go to English conversation."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {英会話|えいかいわ}スクール (English conversation school)
- {英会話|えいかいわ}レッスン (English conversation lesson)
- {英会話|えいかいわ}に{通|かよ}う (to attend English classes)
- オンライン{英会話|えいかいわ} (online English conversation lessons)
- {英会話|えいかいわ}{教室|きょうしつ} (English conversation classroom/school)

Similar compounds exist for other languages: {中国語|ちゅうごくご}{会話|かいわ} (Chinese conversation), {仏|ふつ}{会話|かいわ} (French conversation), etc.
